text:
Dear Lumen Health team,

I am excited to apply for the Product Designer position at Lumen Health. With five years of experience designing patient-facing products at a telehealth startup, I have honed my skills in Figma, user research, prototyping, and developing design systems that resonate with users and meet business objectives.

In my previous role, I led the redesign of our appointment booking flow, successfully reducing drop-off rates by a third. This experience taught me the importance of user-centered design and the impact of a seamless user experience on patient engagement. Additionally, I established a comprehensive component library that was utilized by three different product teams, fostering consistency and efficiency in our design processes.

I prioritize user research and actively run weekly usability sessions with both patients and clinicians. This practice not only informs my design decisions but also allows me to create prioritised backlogs that directly address user needs and pain points. I am particularly impressed by Lumen Health’s commitment to shaping the roadmap through research and would love to contribute to that mission.

I am eager to bring my expertise in user-centric design and collaborative development to the innovative team at Lumen Health. I believe that my background in telehealth aligns well with your goals, and I am excited about the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Sincerely,
